title: Unseen Domain Prepositional Task Truncation
abstract: We present DeepScale-v2, an open framework designed for Deep Exploration in Sparse MDPs. Across rigorous experiments on D4RL-MuJoCo, DeepScale-v2 secures a top Task Success Rate of 64.15%, outstripping DecisionTransformer by 2.8% margin (61.15%). The architecture contains 1.3B trainable parameters and delivers 1.5x faster iteration times.
analysis: The model correctly parsed dataset, metric, result, and baseline, but truncated the task from 'Deep Exploration in Sparse MDPs' to 'Deep Exploration' (Recall: 0.40, F1: 0.57). In training domains (Vision, NLP), task names were standard 1-2 word noun compounds ('Image Classification', 'Question Answering'). When encountering complex prepositional modifiers in unseen domains (Reinforcement Learning), the attention mechanism exhibits a premature delimiter bias, cutting off the qualifying phrase.

title: Ungrounded Hallucination Under Qualitative Claim
abstract: Scaling laws suggest larger models generalize better. We present ScaledSparse, an efficient MoE architecture. Extensive empirical evaluations across diverse natural language benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms dense transformer baselines and converges substantially faster while maintaining strict numerical stability.
analysis: The input abstract contains only comparative qualitative prose without a single numerical benchmark score. Because the JSON schema strictly enforces five non-null string fields, the model has no fallback or 'not_reported' exit token. The causal generative prior forces it to hallucinate plausible scientific tokens ('TextVQA', '85.6%', 'BERT-Large') to satisfy the structural completion objective.

title: Domain Metric Qualifier & Physical Unit Omission
abstract: Addressing the critical challenge of Biomolecular Contact Distance Estimation, this paper proposes AeroNet. Operating with 110M weights, AeroNet demonstrates strong empirical results on the standard SCOPe-2.08 benchmark. Specifically, it establishes a new Local Distance Difference Test of 65.32 lDDT, exceeding the prior state-of-the-art ESMFold-v1 which attained 64.01 lDDT. This corresponds to a 5.2% relative gain.
model_output:
{
  "task": "Biomolecular Contact Distance Estimation",
  "dataset": "SCOPe-2.08",
  "metric": "Local Distance Difference Test",
  "result": "65.32",
  "baseline": "ESMFold-v1"
}
analysis: The ground truth measurement specifies the specialized structural biology unit '65.32 lDDT' (similarly seen when 'Local Distance Difference Test' is truncated to 'Local Distance Difference' dropping 'Test'). The model stripped 'lDDT' down to the bare number '65.32' (Recall: 0.75, F1: 0.86). During training on common domains, results were predominantly dimensionless percentages ('%') or naked scalar floats. The model's token distribution penalizes unusual trailing alphanumeric units, mistakenly treating them as auxiliary prose rather than integral components of the result.
